questions.q: Who is known as the father of modern physical education in India?
questions.qPa: ਭਾਰਤ ਵਿੱਚ ਆਧੁਨਿਕ ਸਰੀਰਕ ਸਿੱਖਿਆ ਦਾ ਪਿਤਾਮਾ ਕਿਸਨੂੰ ਕਿਹਾ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ?
questions.explanation: H.C. Buck founded the YMCA College in Madras in 1920, pioneering the movement.

questions.q: In which year was the Lakshmibai National College of Physical Education (LNIPE) established?
questions.explanation: LNIPE was established in Gwalior in 1957, the centenary year of the 1857 revolt.

questions.q: Which of the following was the first systematic sports coaching scheme in India, introduced in 1953?
questions.explanation: The Rajkumari Amrit Kaur Coaching Scheme was introduced by the Health Minister to provide expert coaching.

questions.q: Who was the first President of the Indian Olympic Association (IOA) formed in 1927?
questions.qPa: 1927 ਵਿੱਚ ਬਣੀ ਭਾਰਤੀ ਓਲੰਪਿਕ ਐਸੋਸੀਏਸ਼ਨ (IOA) ਦੇ ਪਹਿਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਧਾਨ ਕੌਣ ਸਨ?
questions.explanation: Sir Dorabji Tata was the first president, and Dr. Noehren was the secretary.

questions.q: Where is the Netaji Subhas National Institute of Sports (NSNIS) located?
questions.explanation: NSNIS was established in Patiala in 1961 to train high-caliber coaches.

questions.q: The Tara Chand Committee was formed in which year?
questions.explanation: The Tara Chand Committee was set up immediately after independence in 1948.

questions.q: Who served as the first principal of LNIPE, Gwalior?
questions.explanation: Dr. P.M. Joseph was the pioneering first principal of the institute.

questions.q: The Sports Authority of India (SAI) was established in:
questions.qPa: ਸਪੋਰਟਸ ਅਥਾਰਟੀ ਆਫ ਇੰਡੀਆ (SAI) ਦੀ ਸਥਾਪਨਾ ਕਦੋਂ ਹੋਈ ਸੀ?
questions.explanation: SAI was established in 1984, primarily to manage the infrastructure created for the 1982 Asian Games.
